description: 40x40 map using the profile's standard mapping, every cell starting as mapping 0. Paint every cell 'mud' and resolve with no region (seed 1234). Draw a cliff through (20,6) -> (20,20) -> (36,20), high side LEFT (0), wall height 3, seed 7. Hash the tile grid (mapping index per cell, row by row) with FNV-1a 64 over each value's 4 little-endian bytes.
